# Dense-grid monotonicity analysis

| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `analyze_dense_grid_tables.R` | CLI that consumes materialized attractor or initial-ploidy tables. |
| `dense_grid_analysis_utils.R` | Pointwise/smoothed curve classification, reliability, objective tests, initial-condition deltas, and convergence summaries. |

Canonical outputs are under `analysis_tables/`; established filenames are also
written under `tables/` for downstream compatibility.
